selection_rationale.summary: The supplied facts contain a changed gate-alpha observation and a replay using the same recorded input. A bounded replay probe is therefore directly relevant: it compares two live explanations while keeping the input fixed, preserves the missing gate-beta reading as unknown, and does not require external knowledge.
selection_rationale.source_bound_rationale: The supplied method history says to select this probe when an observation changes and replay can separate an input-dependent effect from a readout artifact.

source_facts: At checkpoint P0, channel left=6 and channel right=6.
After gate alpha, channel left=6 and channel right=4.
A replay using the same recorded input at gate alpha reports left=6 and right=6.
At gate beta, the right-channel reading is missing.
No timing, operator, device, or causal explanation is supplied.
constraints: replay input must be held constant
no external causal explanation may be added
the result is observation-only and research-only

expected_discriminating_observation.probe: Hold the recorded gate-alpha input constant and compare the original post-alpha reading with the replay reading channel by channel.
expected_discriminating_observation.replay_consistent_case: If the replay reproduced right=4 while left remained 6, the changed right-channel observation would be replay-consistent under this bounded probe.
expected_discriminating_observation.non_reproduced_case: If the replay returned right=6 while the original post-alpha reading was right=4, the right-channel change would not be reproduced by the same recorded input, providing the intended observation-level discrimination from the replay.
expected_discriminating_observation.unknown_preservation: Neither branch establishes causation; an incomplete or missing reading remains unresolved.

application.input: The supplied gate-alpha observation and its supplied same-recorded-input replay.
steps: Use P0=(left=6,right=6) only as the supplied checkpoint reference.
Hold the recorded gate-alpha input constant.
Compare the original after-alpha observation with the replay result separately for left and right.
Do not fill in or infer the missing gate-beta right-channel reading.

observed_outcome_or_failure.observed_outcome: The same-input replay preserved left=6 but returned right=6 instead of the original after-alpha right=4. The right-channel change was therefore not reproduced by the supplied replay, while the left channel was replay-consistent.
observed_outcome_or_failure.bounded_interpretation: This is a discriminating observation at the comparison/readout level only. It does not identify whether the right-channel difference arose from an input-dependent effect, a readout artifact, timing, instrumentation, or another unprovided state.
observed_outcome_or_failure.failure_or_limitation: The gate-beta right-channel reading is missing, so the probe cannot be extended to beta or used to resolve that missing observation.
